actions.action: Check plant label/seller listing or post photo to plant ID sub to confirm ID
Pull out the Mother of Thousands including plantlets and roots
Slide plant out of pot and inspect roots for root-binding
If root-bound, repot into fresh cactus mix in a pot one size larger with drainage holes
Check roots for rot and trim brown/mushy roots, repot in dry mix
Water when top inch of soil is dry
After 1-2 weeks, feed with balanced fertilizer at half strength
Move plant gradually to bright indirect light if in harsh sun

reason: The answer mentions nutrient shortage and the Kalanchoe but leads with competition and misses the fast-draining soil cause; its feeding and Kalanchoe-removal advice overlaps the thread, but it suggests repotting into cactus mix (fast-draining) rather than the less-draining soil that fixed it, though only conditionally, so not clearly harmful.
